description: This file defines core classes and functions for image loading and processing in the Kivy framework, including Image, ImageData, ImageLoader, and related utilities. It handles image caching, provider selection, data URI loading, zip sequences, and supports multiple image formats and providers.

classes.name: ImageData
classes.description: Container for image data and mipmaps, supporting various formats and vertical flipping.

classes.name: ImageLoaderBase
classes.description: Base class for image loader implementations, providing load, save, and populate methods.

classes.name: ImageLoader
classes.description: Manages registration and selection of image loader providers, including zip and atlas loaders.

classes.name: Image
classes.description: Represents an image object that loads, caches, and manages image textures, supporting animations, data URI loading, and saving.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Function to load an image by filename or data URI.
